evidence_excerpts: Stock Perpetuals ... track the price of publicly traded stocks (e.g. AAPL, TSLA, NVDA).
Trading pair format: [TICKER]USDT (e.g. AAPLUSDT, TSLAUSDT, NVDAUSDT).
OKX supports 24/7 trading for stock perpetuals.
US Stock Market Regular Market: 9:30 AM – 4:00 PM ET; Closed on weekends and US market holidays.
During regular market hours, the index draws from all sources, with stock price feeds carrying significant weight.
During off-hours, weekends, and holidays, the index relies more on OKX's own contract price and stock perps index price on other exchanges.

Index Bands Protection: index price limited within a 10% range of the stock price (Pyth). During off-hours... stock prices stop updating, but the last available stock price is still used for index bands calculation.
Mark Price = Index Price + Basis Moving Average; same logic as regular perpetual swaps.
Price limits follow the same logic as regular perpetual swaps; parameters may vary by stock.
Funding: standard funding rate mechanism; settlement intervals may vary by product — see contract specification page.
